svg.title: VisionIQ 07 - Human gate and outcome learning
svg.text: HUMAN GATE — Decisions and Outcome Learning
AI proposes, engineers decide. Every decision is recorded; only new verified or disputed evidence changes knowledge.
Draft PR or guidance in ADO
• Evidence trail and real check results in the
• Each advice item: accept, modify, reject or not
• Owned by Azure DevOps, outside model control
• Bot identity: read, branch and PR rights only
• Approval is not proof of correctness
• Reacts to deploy, revert, reopen, incident events
• Bounded window from deployment, then UNKNOWN
• Verified effective · regressed or reverted · disputed ·
• Link existing · revise existing · fork by scope · create new · human review
• New knowledge version only when evidence materially changes
• CI green, approval or no incident is not proof the advice was right
• Repeated approvals never create duplicate lessons
Two independent states per advice item
Engineer disposition — what the engineer did
Evidence judgment — what tests, review and later outcomes show
